item.text: I’m checking the notice text directly and looking for the inspection date in the opening sections or any “inspection” references.
`rg` isn’t available here, so I’m using plain text search and a quick read of the notice header to find the inspection date.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'grep -inE "inspection|inspected|PHMSA|date of inspection|inspection conducted|conducted an inspection" "/mnt/data/LSF/data/nopv/text/12026032NOPV_PCO_02132026_ (25-330095).txt" | head -n 50'
